name: Sidie Hollow County Park, Main and Upper Ridge Campgrounds
waterfront_evidence: Split 2026-11-17, this entry = Main (201-230) + Upper Ridge (301-330). County detailed camping map (https://cms8.revize.com/revize/vernoncountywi/Park%20Overview%20&%20Detailed%20Camping.pdf, read 2026-11-17) draws Coe Hollow Creek along the east side of electric sites 209-218, east of County Road XX. Esri World_Imagery read 2026-11-17 at 43.5468,-90.9603 (100 m half-width, rendered): two trailers on the 214-218 row at ~43.5464-43.5466,-90.9604 on open mown grass, the creek (a few metres wide) ~20-25 m east of them with no road, lot or tree screen between -> creekside for 214-218. 209-213 follow the same creek further north but sit among scattered trees and their pads are not resolved, so they are not claimed. The lake starts ~250 m south of the electric row past the day-use lot (no lake value). Upper Ridge (hw 140 m at 43.5412,-90.9655, rendered): sites on a wooded ridge, DEM 366 m against ~281-290 m at the lake, ~160 m from the water through continuous forest -> no water value. Not below the dam: the Main area is at the lake's inflow (Coe Hollow Creek), DEM 296 m, upstream of the dam at the lake's west end. Replaces p3-503's not-waterfront call, which left this as a creekside lead. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Vernon County Sidie Hollow page (https://www.vernoncountywi.gov/departments/land_and_water_conservation/parks_and_forests/sidie_hollow.php, read 2026-11-17): '85 campsites'; 'a nice mix of rustic tent sites with no utilities, electric sites, and full hookup RV sites', reservations via Campspot. County detailed camping map (https://cms8.revize.com/revize/vernoncountywi/Park%20Overview%20&%20Detailed%20Camping.pdf, read 2026-11-17): 'Main Campground Area E6051 County Road XX' sites 201-230 (electric 209-218 and 226-230, full hookup 225, rustic 201-208 and 219-224) and 'Upper Ridge Campground S5001 Campsite Road' sites 301-330 (electric and water 303-316, rustic 301-302 and 317-330). The county's Campspot engine (2026-10-13 capture) lists the Electric, Electric + Water and Full Hook Up types to 40 ft with Motorhome among the rig types. A real county drive-in RV campground a 23-ft rig fits.
note: Vernon County park near Viroqua around a 38-acre flood-control lake, with trout streams, fishing piers, a boat launch and about 10 miles of hiking and mountain-bike trails. This entry covers two of its three campgrounds: the Main area on County Road XX, where electric sites 214-218 sit on open grass beside Coe Hollow Creek, and Upper Ridge on a wooded ridge west of the lake, which is reached by its own road, Campsite Road, off Sidie Hollow Road rather than from the Main area. Boat Landing, the third, has its own entry. --Claude

sites.note: Main (201-230): 15 electric, full-hookup site 225 and 14 rustic. Upper Ridge (301-330): 14 electric-and-water and 16 rustic. Campspot lists all but one of the park's 35 rustic sites under 23 ft.

facilities.note: Showers and the dump station are in the Main area; Upper Ridge has restrooms and fresh water.

booking.note: Advance (online) reservations need 2 nights and close 3 days before arrival; from each Wednesday unreserved sites go first-come for that weekend. Check-in noon, check-out 11 am. The caretaker's office in the Main campground area also takes reservations.

fees.note: Vernon County 2026: electric $30 a night (Main), electric and water $40 (Upper Ridge), full hookups $55 (site 225); rustic sites $20 (mostly under 23 ft). A full week is six nights' charge (seventh night free); 30-day rates $450-825, a full season on the full-hookup site $2,000. $8 reservation/processing fee, kept on cancellation. Campspot adds its own booking fee at checkout.

curation_note: Split 2026-11-17: this id kept the Main area (201-230) and Upper Ridge (301-330); Boat Landing (101-125, ~1.3 km SE) became a new entry. Upper Ridge stayed here: its own road, but its site centroid is ~0.8 km from Main's (under the ~1 km rule). Pin moved from the day-use turnaround at the south end (43.5451,-90.9604) to the Main electric row. Waterfront not waterfront -> creekside (214-218). --Claude
_reasons: Split: Boat Landing (1.29 km centroid to centroid, own road and address) leaves; Upper Ridge (0.80 km, own road off Sidie Hollow Road) fails the ~1 km test and stays here. Pin was the day-use turnaround, now on the Main electric row; waterfront re-audited (creekside 214-218 on imagery + county map); sites 85 -> 60, fees/hookups/facilities rewritten for Main + Upper Ridge; season and booking unchanged in value, re-read. Rating stays on this id (one RV Life record for the park).
